anchor: A check file name may not hold or sit inside another (suite-runner.sh namelint): requests-inbox.sh fails on inbox.sh (agent-harness-2026-11-07-3 2026-11-07)
text: A note given before the curator session is reverted by its restrict: note after ro_rescue, as curator() does (agent-harness-2026-11-08 2026-11-08)
why: A silently reverted harness-log note is invisible until a check misses it; the namelint line it evicts fails loudly with its own message.
